de: **Admin**: Spending Policy mit **Cowork** aktivieren (**Microsoft 365 Admin Center › Copilot › Cost Management**).
**Admin**: **Cowork Browsing** einschalten (**Copilot › Settings › View All › Cowork settings › Allow browser access**) und am Vortag in Edge bei **Contoso Atlas** anmelden.
SAP-Abschnitt: Plugin **arnold** (enosix) hinzufügen und einmal anmelden.
Skill **skills\contoso-golive-readiness\SKILL.md** in der Demo hochladen (**Customize › Skills › Upload skill**).
en: **Admin**: turn on a spending policy that includes **Cowork** (**Microsoft 365 admin center › Copilot › Cost Management**).
**Admin**: turn on **Cowork Browsing** (**Copilot › Settings › View All › Cowork settings › Allow browser access**) and sign in to **Contoso Atlas** in Edge the day before.
SAP section: add the **arnold** plugin (enosix) and sign in once.
Upload the skill **skills\contoso-golive-readiness\SKILL.md** during the demo (**Customize › Skills › Upload skill**).
